title: PostVisitCheck
description: Post-visit recovery monitoring record. Post-Visit Agent collects pain scores, symptoms, detects red flags via NLP, and triggers escalation for clinical deterioration.

checkId.description: Unique post-visit check identifier. Format: PVC-XXXXXXXX.

checkInTime.description: Timestamp when the automated check-in was initiated.

responseReceivedAt.description: Timestamp when patient responded. Null if no response yet.

painScore.description: Patient-reported pain score (0=no pain, 10=worst pain). Score >= 7 triggers escalation regardless of text content.

symptoms.description: Structured symptoms extracted from patient free-text by NLP.

freeTextResponse.description: Raw free-form text response from the patient.

detected.description: Whether any red-flag phrases were identified.

category.description: Red-flag category as per required classifier.

matchedPhrase.description: The exact phrase from patient text that triggered the flag.

confidence.description: NLP confidence score for the detection.

flags.description: List of all red flags detected. Minimum detectable: worsening pain, bleeding, shortness of breath, fever >38.5°C, medication side effects.

conflictDetected.description: True if pain score contradicts text (e.g., high score but patient says 'I'm fine'). Triggers escalation.

temperatureReported.description: Patient-reported temperature in Celsius. > 38.5 triggers red flag.

conversationLog.description: Full multi-turn conversation history for this check-in.

type.description: Escalation type. Emergency = immediate, Clinical = within SLA window.

slaDeadline.description: SLA deadline for response to escalation.

nextFollowUp.description: Scheduled next follow-up check-in. Null if recovery complete.

status.description: Current status of the post-visit check.
